entities.summary: Matthew Kaye is an American professional wrestler, professional wrestling commentator, actor and former high school teacher, signed to Major League Wrestling, using the ring name Matt Striker as a commentator. During his career he has worked for WWE, Impact Wrestling, Lucha Libre AAA World Wide, and Lucha Underground.
